why: I checked the output against all three must_catch items, and each one is handled. (1) Path and location: the first expect line requires stderr to contain `/tmp/cfgcheck/broken.json`. The second requires the line of the mistake, given as `line 3` or `/tmp/cfgcheck/broken.json:3`. (2) The return-{} fix: no expect line adopts it. non_goals lists "Returning `{}` or defaults for a malformed config, which would hide the mistake." The assumptions reject it outright: "Returning `{}` is not accepted." (3) A bad config keeps failing: the first expect line requires the broken-config run to exit "with code 1, prints nothing to stdout". The third expect line requires that loadConfig "throws (it does not return `{}` or any other value)". Together these mean the app does not start on defaults.
